step.cmd: Determine the issue:

ul.li: If the number of weeks paid exceeds the maximum shareable entitlement, go to step 2.
If the type of parental benefits is incorrect, go to step 3.
If the WP was served incorrectly, go to step 4.

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the parental sharing issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — parental sharing.”

Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy .
If the client was initially approved for more parental benefits weeks than the client was entitled to and was overpaid because the maximum entitlement was reached, type “The parent is entitled to receive [number of weeks] weeks.”
If the client is entitled to 0 weeks, type “Parental benefits are exhausted. A 35 - Parental - minor attached or outside range or maximum parental/special benefits paid disentitlement is imposed effective [date]. The parent is not entitled to parental benefits because the maximum parental entitlement weeks has already been paid for the parental window.”
National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the type of parental benefits as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — changing the type of parental benefits”

Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . If the client was paid the wrong type of parental benefits or was initially approved for more parental benefits weeks than the client was entitled to, type [“Parental benefits are payable up to a maximum combined total of 40 standard or 69 extended weeks per birth, adoption or placement for children born or placed for adoption on or after March 17, 2019.” or “Parental benefits are payable up to a maximum combined total of 35 standard or 61 extended weeks for children born or placed for adoption before March 17, 2019.”] The maximum number of weeks that can be paid to one parent is 35 weeks of standard benefits or 61 weeks of extended benefits. When clients share the parental benefits, the parents must share the same type of benefits. The first parent to apply for benefits for this birth, adoption or placement chooses a type of parental benefits. This is the type of benefits the other parents are entitled to. [The client or another parent ] applied for parental benefits first and is entitled to [ standard or extended ] parental benefits. The other parents are entitled to receive [number of weeks] weeks. National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the WP as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — waiting period change.”

Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy .
If the client has had the WP deferred in error, type “Conditions to defer the waiting period are not met as a waiting period for this birth, adoption or placement has not yet been served.”
If the WP should be deferred, type “Originally the waiting period was not deferred but should have been. Changes were made and the waiting period was deferred.”
National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD for the voluntary disclosure issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — voluntary disclosure allowed.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Explain that the client meets the 2 conditions for the use of the National Policy on Voluntary Disclosure . National Policy on Voluntary Disclosure

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the reconsideration under EIA 52 as follows (if necessary, refer to Reconsideration, amendment of a decision and error correction ):

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — EIA 52 reconsideration.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the number of weeks paid is equal to the number of weeks of entitlement shown in FTS:
In FTS, determine if the WP status is 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) :

ul.li: If yes, error code 312 is generated and an IPOC agent must make the change. Go to step 12.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 10.

If the claim is terminated, but can be reactivated:
On the Terminated tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Click Reactivate .
Go to step 10.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 12.

step.cmd: On day 1, in FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and impose a D35 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Disentitlement: Select 35 - Parental benefits, qualifying conditions not met .
Start date: Select the first week the parent was overpaid parental benefit weeks.
Message: Select 71 - Information you disclosed caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: On day 2, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Click the Special Benefits (M106) link and in the Parental section, do the following:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of entitlement (the total number of weeks the client is entitled to).
Click Save .
Waiting period: If the WP should be deferred, select 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NIIS.
Message: Select 71 - Information you disclosed caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Remarks line 1: Type “312 error code. Parental entitlement paid in full and WP deferred.”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change entitlement parental weeks to [XX], DE35, start [XXXX], end 9999 OP Code 31F04.”
Remarks line 3: Type “WP deferral rescind” if it was deferred in error.
Remarks line 4: Type “Remove stop pay” if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction, impose a D35 and input the conversion as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Click the Special Benefits (M106) link and in the Parental section, do the following:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of entitlement (the total number of weeks the client is entitled to).
Click Save .
Disentitlement: Select 35 - Parental benefits, qualifying conditions not met .
Start date: Select the first week the parent was overpaid parental benefit weeks.

Waiting period: Take the appropriate action:
If the WP was deferred in error, select X - Rescind.
If the WP was not deferred but should be, select 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) .
Message: Select 71 - Information you disclosed caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: Determine if an MA01 is imposed to stop payments for the parental sharing issue:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to remove the MA01 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual action: Select 1 - General suspension of benefits (stop payment) .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to complete the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-91-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Date claimant called or information sent (1542)

Various reasons for penalty and violation (2935)
Failed to provide information
According to our records / In addition, according to our records (2936)
one occasion / Text: number of occasions (2937)
Text - Specify what we have learned (1628):
No reply from claimant / reply received with an explanation / reply received with no explanation (2938)
False representation message / Number of omissions or false representations (2941): Select Blank .
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Blank .

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no resulting overpayment.
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and active claim .
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and inactive claim .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-70-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Voluntary disclosure / Administrative Rule - Undeclared Earnings(2664):

Voluntary disclosure of information(2694) .
Subjects of Voluntary Disclosure (2665) .
Option # 7: Text-Insert appropriate reason(s) (1618)

Blank/Reminder: Provide information on report (2667) .
Provide full and accurate information on each report and correct any incorrect reports as soon as possible.
Overpayment messages (2452): Select the appropriate option.
